brief.title: Verify the run brief
brief.imperative: Confirm the run brief is present and complete: run/epic intent, project-customized templates (TEMPLATES_MANIFEST diff), model tiers used, artifact paths. If missing or incomplete, stop and report — do not audit blind.
brief.finding: Run brief complete: epic intent (dogfood-debt paydown + superpowers imports), 19 issues/21 PRs/#58 deferred, model tiers (opus engine/code, sonnet doctrine), templates = bundled (source repo, no customization), all artifact paths present and readable.

logs.title: Audit the run log
logs.imperative: Read the ADMIRAL_LOG (or the Commander spine state for a non-fleet run). Extract candidates from RULINGs, INCIDENTs, ADMIRAL ERRORs, and recoveries: what was improvised, what was relearned, what a template or skill should have carried. Cite the log line for each.
logs.finding: ADMIRAL_LOG audited: doctrine seam flagged twice (wave4b-71 RULING staged-harvest vs issue-73 mechanical write-through) -> commander-worktree-local-durable-writes-under-epic; attest lesson flagged suspicious for closeout verify; dormancy auto-delete of verify-launch-order-baseline-vs-code at tick 19; cap crunch (issue-61 parked delta) resolved by post-merge paydowns.

feedback.title: Audit the feedback entries
feedback.imperative: Read the AGENT_FEEDBACK entries for this run/epic. Extract candidates from friction, adherence deviations, and improvement signals. Weight friction the run worked around over friction merely asserted.
feedback.finding: 22 AGENT_FEEDBACK entries audited. issue-74 two cap-deferred candidates distilled (doc-only-gate-inspection-postcondition, commander-worktree-local-durable-writes-under-epic). issue-47 baseline-reconciliation re-added. Friction worked-around (STATE_NOTE/docs-agents substitution) outranks asserted.

crew.title: Audit crew workflow feedback
crew.imperative: Read every crew Workflow Feedback section (IMPLEMENTER_RESULT / REVIEW_RESULT). Consolidate phrase-different duplicates. Handoff gaps reported by multiple crews are the strongest handoff-scope candidates.
crew.finding: Crew Workflow Feedback consolidated across gates. Doc-only proxy-check pattern (issue-74 g2 + issue-73 g1 r4-quality) corroborates doc-only-gate-inspection-postcondition across two runs. Reviewer-handoff review-target already shipped (issue-73 dogfooded it). Handoff-family lessons (map-counts, dogfood-aid) kept distinct.

telemetry.title: Corroborate with engine telemetry
telemetry.imperative: Cross-check candidates against telemetry: rework_count per task, BLOCK verdicts, waives/forced overrides, re-dispatches, incident counts. Mark each candidate corroborated or assertion-only; raise confidence only with corroboration.
telemetry.finding: Telemetry cross-check: attest-which lesson DISCONFIRMED against checklist_engine.py attest() two-list fallback (lines 1035-1036,1072) on main d442845 -> retire. dogfood-context-paths-absent confirmed=4 >= apply_confirmed=3 AND doctrine target -> drill-gated apply; drill run (before/after arm), PASS. No BLOCK/rework contradicts the added candidates.

playbook.title: Reconcile against the existing playbook
playbook.imperative: Read .agent-work/LESSONS.md (Active). Map candidates to existing lessons: re-validations become confirm ops, contradictions become disconfirm ops, near-duplicates merge. Flag Active lessons this run's evidence undermines even if no one complained.
playbook.finding: Reconciled 10 active. apply dogfood-context-paths-absent (drill PASS); retire attest-which-precondition-default-silent (disconfirmed); add 3 (doc-only-gate-inspection-postcondition, commander-worktree-local-durable-writes-under-epic, verify-launch-order-baseline-vs-code re-add). No true one-lesson-two-ids duplicate: --from-child pair (path-resolves vs requires-consolidation) judged distinct failure modes+targets; cap relieved to 11/20.

consolidate.title: Consolidate scoped candidates
consolidate.imperative: Produce LESSON_CANDIDATES from templates/LESSON_CANDIDATES.template.md: every candidate scoped, grounded, routed, confidence-rated; discard anything without a citation; include the ready-to-apply lessons-delta.json block for playbook ops. You nominate — do not apply anything.
consolidate.finding: LESSON_CANDIDATES + ready-to-apply closeout-lessons-delta.json (validated dry-run: 11 active, run 20, 0 unexpected auto-deletes) + drill record produced. Dormancy-mechanism + both-lists-collision routed to Admiral (not self-applied).

consolidation.summary: 7/7 items pass. 5 delta ops (1 apply drill-PASS, 1 retire, 3 add), tick to run 20 -> 11 active. Drill PASS. 3 items routed to Admiral (dormancy mechanism, both-lists-collision hardening, doctrine-seam single-rule). No unrouted observations.
